Name: Zebadiah, the Levite
Summary: Zebadiah was one of the Levites sent with Jehoshaphat's princes to teach the book of the law throughout Judah.
KeyStory: With the princes went Levites, including Zebadiah, and they went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught the people.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
